name: run-meta
title: RunMeta
description: The meta line under a run header: muted key + value pairs that wrap (Endpoint, Runner, Started, Duration, Launched by). Used on TestRun, AgentTestRun and WorkflowRun.

a11y.pattern: Native <dl>: each pair is a <div> with a <dt> and one or two <dd>
aria: Screen readers announce each key with its value
A url value is only coloured like a link: wrap it in a real <a href> when it navigates
a11y.notes: Muted keys and the muted date keep 4.5:1. Values wrap (overflow-wrap: anywhere), so a long endpoint never widens the page.
